label: Wilfrid Sellars, Empiricism and the…: Sellars retains observation reports’ distinctive supporting…
interpretation: He explicitly refuses to treat empirical knowledge as rumor or hoax and retains an asymmetry between observation reports and other propositions. His reciprocal-dependence proposal concerns different logical dimensions; it is not an endorsement of deriving a proposition from itself along one inferential relation, nor a mere consistency theory.
